title: Simple Circuits
description: Added some useful items and blocks about the circuits
body:
# Simple Circuits
## Something a little bit about circuits

---

## Blocks
### Block Placer
Place a block at its head end when receiving a redstone pulse

### Lodestone Debris
9 lodestone debris = 1 lodestone

### Ancient Circuits
As an ore, it drops random items from this module when mined. Perhaps they were left behind by our ancestors?

### Electric Bars (Wrong Translation,it means Electric Fence)
When touched, it triggers a lightning effect and imposes a minor punishment on the player

---

## Items
### Copper String
Ingredients: copper ingot + redstone powder + string

### Electromagnet
As an ingredient

### Motor
As an ingredient

### Night Vision Googles
Wearing it will give the player night vision effect

### Electronic Ankle Bracelet/Electronic Ankle Bracelet Set
Bind a location with a setter and keep players who wear it within a certain distance circle from that point(Just understand it as an electronic ankle bracelet with a designated area)

---
